en.summary: Clearer results screens, a built-in guided assistant, safer saving and better update information.
items: Results & Analysis is clearer: one ordered workspace, a collapsible class summary, a remembered results order, and a warning when a search limits what will print.
Master Results has complete, natural English and Kiswahili headings and footers, a clearer scope label, and zero grade counts left blank.
Class teacher details now sit in Class Organization when you set up an examination.
The sidebar and top bar fit smaller screens better, buttons respond consistently, and the Ask button no longer wraps.
SSR Assistant gives built-in guided help that works offline. It uses no AI model and cannot change your records.

Saving is safer: the leave-page message tells the truth when a retry has saved your work, a new pupil row with only a placeholder name is never saved, and Load latest in Examination Sets asks before replacing unsaved edits.
Update history, a What’s new message after updating, notes you can read before updating, and six new Help and Guide topics.

sw.summary: Skrini za matokeo zilizo wazi zaidi, msaidizi wa kuongozwa uliojengwa ndani, uhifadhi salama zaidi na taarifa bora za masasisho.
items: Matokeo na Uchambuzi ni wazi zaidi: eneo moja lenye mpangilio, muhtasari wa darasa unaofunguka, mpangilio wa matokeo unaokumbukwa, na onyo utafutaji unapopunguza kinachochapishwa.
Matokeo Makuu yana vichwa na vichwa vya chini kamili na vya kawaida kwa Kiingereza na Kiswahili, lebo iliyo wazi ya wigo, na idadi ya daraja sifuri imeachwa wazi.
Maelezo ya mwalimu wa darasa sasa yako kwenye Mpangilio wa Darasa unapoandaa mtihani.
Upau wa pembeni na upau wa juu vinatoshea skrini ndogo vizuri zaidi, vitufe vinaitikia kwa usawa, na kitufe cha Uliza hakivunjiki tena.
Msaidizi wa SSR hutoa msaada wa kuongozwa uliojengwa ndani unaofanya kazi bila intaneti. Hautumii modeli ya AI na hauwezi kubadilisha rekodi zako.

Uhifadhi ni salama zaidi: ujumbe wa kuondoka kwenye ukurasa husema ukweli pale jaribio la kuhifadhi tena limehifadhi kazi yako, safu mpya ya mwanafunzi yenye jina la mfano tu haihifadhiwi kamwe, na Pakia ya Hivi Karibuni kwenye Seti za Mitihani huuliza kabla ya kubadilisha mabadiliko ambayo hayajahifadhiwa.
Historia ya masasisho, ujumbe wa Mapya baada ya kusasisha, maelezo unayoweza kusoma kabla ya kusasisha, na mada sita mpya za Msaada na Mwongozo.
